chunks: From him, from Salih, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskaan, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, from Tamim ibn Hatim, who said:

We were with the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), and the earth trembled, so he gestured to it with his hand, then said to it: 'Calm down! What is the matter with you?' Then he turned to us and said: 'Indeed, had it been the one of which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said, it would have answered me, but it is not that one.'

key_terms.مَا لَكِ: What is the matter with you?

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the minor tremor and the major earthquake mentioned in the Quran according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* highlights the concept of *al-Isma* (infallibility) and the unique authority (*Sultan*) of Imam Ali (AS) over creation, demonstrating his ability to command natural phenomena by divine permission. The distinction drawn between this minor tremor and the cataclysmic earthquake of the Hereafter underscores the difference between the Imam's subordinate agency and Allah's absolute command, a key theme in Shia exegesis regarding the miracles of the Ahl al-Bayt.
